hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.descriptio.about: an item tooltip for an old ambergris cylinder cut with unfamiliar grooves, telling the player to play it in a Clairaudiograph and bring an analyzed dark sample

hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.heard.about: a short tooltip label marking an Antecedent cylinder recording as already heard

hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.lower_dist.about: the item name of a weathered ambergris cylinder holding the Lower District Survey recording

hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.playback_h.about: a tooltip note that this is an ancient recording and that playing it in the machine preserves both the cylinder and any specimen

hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.severed_re.about: the item name of a weathered ambergris cylinder holding the Severed Record recording

hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.the_quieti.about: the item name of a weathered ambergris cylinder holding The Quieting recording

hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.title.lowe.about: a short title for the Lower District Survey recording

hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.title.seve.about: a short title for the Severed Record recording

hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.title.the_.about: a short title for The Quieting recording

hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.unheard.about: a short tooltip label marking an Antecedent cylinder recording as not yet heard

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.1.about: a scholar saying the recording points to a quiet place below the city, past the end of a wool-lined passage, where the Last Listeners kept watch

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.2.about: a scholar giving directions: follow the Ancient City roads to a small enclosed entrance that could sit beside any district, go through the passage, and keep going when the wool stops

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.3.about: a scholar warning the player to leave the damaged structures alone there, since a missing piece may be why the growth cannot answer itself

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.4.about: a scholar admitting they do not know whether the old work held through skill or through neglect, and asking the player not to test it by putting anything back together

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.title.about: a player response asking where the Last Listeners kept vigil

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.comparison.about: a scholar declining to say the Antecedent and the infection share an Entity, since the similarities seen so far are only on the surface
a scholar explaining that the sculk sample has no blood and answers none of the eight tendencies, so no enzyme can be drawn from it, and that Erythromycelium is something else
a scholar steering the player toward a better question: how each growth spreads and what it needs to stay alive
a scholar contrasting sculk, which stays put and feeds on the dead, with Erythromycelium, which moves through living hosts, and demanding stronger evidence before claiming a shared origin
a player response asking whether the Antecedent could be the same Entity as the fungal infection

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.conclusion.about: the Alchemist admitting they were wrong about the sample: sound makes it move, but it also turned toward the machine when the recording fell silent
the Alchemist reporting that the sound trace stayed flat throughout, yet something was present in the grooves and the sample seemed to sense it
the Alchemist admitting they cannot say what the signal is, since their machine may be missing part of the sound or the old recording may carry something else
the Alchemist noting the speaker said the growth was stopped from answering itself without being killed, and sending the player to the Vicar with the cylinder and the vial
a player response asking what the controlled replay established

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.housing.1.about: the Alchemist explaining the archive shows how to build a small listening device, and offering to make its housing for four iron nuggets and one Echo Shard

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.housing.2.about: the Alchemist giving steps: hold the housing in one hand and an analyzed Ahaematic vial in the other, use the housing to load it, keep it beside the Clairaudiograph through the whole silent section, then fit or remove it at a Scarlet Vanity

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.housing.ti.about: a player response asking to reconstruct a Listening Scar housing

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.initial_al.about: the Alchemist examining the vial, saying the microscope finds no blood cell in it yet the material moves together
the Alchemist asking the player to tap the glass and watch it pull back, and admitting all eight tendencies were tested and none fit
the Alchemist recalling that the Vicar once warned them off a similar account in the old histories, and sending the player to him with the sample
the Alchemist telling the player to keep the vial, learn what makes the material move, and search an Ancient City for records left by people who lived near it
a player response telling the Alchemist that the dark sample has no blood in it

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.initial_vi.about: the Vicar explaining that the Alchemist was right to send the player over a sample that does not behave like blood, though he cannot name it from a vial alone
the Vicar mentioning an old, vague passage that may describe something similar, and refusing to build a history around a single sample
the Vicar sending the player to an Ancient City to find something its people recorded for themselves, since an instruction or field report beats any later account
the Vicar asking the player to bring back whatever they find along with the vial, so he can compare the words with what the sample does
a player response telling the Vicar that the Alchemist sent them with a dark sample

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.recognitio.about: the Vicar reacting to the recording: the speaker says they stopped the growth from answering itself yet it stayed alive, matching an account in the oldest histories
the Vicar describing the old histories' wound that never healed, with living material beneath it, and noting they say the break held without explaining what was broken
the Vicar noting the account has no author, date or named rite, that the Second Age read it as a lesson in restraint, and that this recording strains that reading
the Vicar speculating that if the speaker meant the sculk, they may have cut the way its parts answer each other, and the growth survived the loss
the Vicar insisting this is still a guess: the growth reacted to a recording, but it is unproven that it speaks, remembers or understands
the Vicar explaining that later writers called these fragments the Antecedent for seeming older than blood, and that the city's own name for it is unknown

the Vicar urging the player to find the place where the damaged growth was watched, since their records may say what they separated and why the sculk was left alive, and to ask about the Last Listeners when ready
a player response asking what the old recording meant

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.recording..about: the Alchemist inspecting the ambergris cylinder and noting its grooves came from a different machine, so its makers also knew how to store a recording
the Alchemist reacting to the player's report of a silent section by noting another trace on the spectrograph there, though the machine plays no sound
the Alchemist telling the player to bring the analyzed dark sample back, place it in or beside the Clairaudiograph, and play the cylinder again
the Alchemist asking the player to set the machine within eight blocks for a full replay, noting a sample reacting only to sound should sit still through the silence
a player response saying they found an old recording beneath an Ancient City

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.1.about: the Alchemist questioning the player about when the sample climbed the glass toward the machine, then accepting that it was during the silence and asking to see it

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.2.about: the Alchemist saying they want to watch it happen themselves and asking the player to set up the cylinder again

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.3.about: the Alchemist instructing the player to put the analyzed vial beside the machine and play the whole silent section within eight blocks while watching both traces

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.4.about: the Alchemist stating the test: if the vial moves while the sound trace stays flat, ordinary sound is not the cause

hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.tit.about: a player response reporting that the sample reacted during the silence

hemomancy.antecedent.epilogue.about: the Antecedent speaking as a collective, "we", at the end of the Last Listeners vigil: they remember waiting here for the dead and no longer wait

hemomancy.antecedent.housing.cost.about: a tooltip line stating the reconstruction costs four iron nuggets and one Echo Shard

hemomancy.antecedent.microscope.acoustic.about: a microscope readout line stating the stimulus is acoustic and no nervous structures are observed

hemomancy.antecedent.microscope.readout.about: a multi-line microscope analysis readout listing unknown substrate, no hematic content, null enzyme response, indeterminate cellularity, reactive motility, classification incertae

hemomancy.antecedent.microscope.unknown_.about: a microscope readout line reporting a vibrational unknown stimulus with coordinated motility but no matching acoustic stimulus

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.behind.about: a bracketed caption describing a click behind the listener that is not on the recording

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.crackle.about: a bracketed caption for cylinder crackle and distant cavern sounds

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.crash.about: a bracketed caption for a crash that draws the heartbeats away

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.heartbeat.about: a bracketed caption for heavy heartbeats approaching

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.quieting..about: an unknown recorder issuing terse rules: no bells below the third stair, no iron wheels, wrap the road, walk softly
a distant voice warning to leave if the floor answers twice and, if it answers three times, not to return for those below

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.1.about: an unknown recorder opening a log entry by naming the lower district and record nineteen
an unknown recorder answering a question with a bare admission of not knowing
an unknown recorder stating that they cut the voice
an unknown recorder stating that the flesh remained after the cut

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.2.about: an unknown recorder reporting that the growth to the west has stopped

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.3.about: a distant voice repeating the word stopped as a question

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.4.about: an unknown recorder correcting that the growth has not died but stopped

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.5.about: an unknown recorder reporting that the catalysts still take the dead and the listeners still answer movement, so nothing there has changed

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.6.about: an unknown recorder observing that the parts no longer answer one another as they did

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.7.about: an unknown recorder ordering everyone not to move

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.8.about: an unknown recorder stating that the cut held

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.9.about: a distant voice asking why they are still alive if the cut held

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.shriek.about: a bracketed caption for a distant Shrieker

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.silence.about: a bracketed caption stating there is no audible signal

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.survey.1.about: an unknown recorder reading a lower district survey: the growth takes the dead, and the listeners answer movement but do not pass the black floor

hemomancy.antecedent.recording.survey.2.about: a distant voice ordering that the growth not be carried upward, the dead kept elsewhere, and the last clean stair marked

hemomancy.antecedent.sample.identified.about: an item tooltip stating the sample is alive but not blood, shows no tendency response, reacts to vibration, and is unsuitable for injection or enzyme separation

hemomancy.antecedent.sample.unknown.about: an item tooltip describing an opaque gritty suspension and telling the player to examine it with a Hematic Microscope

hemomancy.antecedent.scar.awakened.about: a short tooltip stating the Listening Scar has awakened and answers

hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.0.about: a tooltip instruction to hold analyzed Ahaematic Colloid in the other hand and use the item, noting it returns the empty vial

hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.1.about: a tooltip instruction to hold the item beside the Clairaudiograph through the entire silent response

hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.2.about: a tooltip telling the player to fit it to their Charm at a Scarlet Vanity, with a closing line that they cannot hear the sculk but can hear it listen

hemomancy.antecedent.scar.socket.about: a tooltip stating the Listening Scar socket can be fitted or removed at a Scarlet Vanity

hemomancy.antecedent.vigil.subtitle.about: a subtitle telling the player to pass where the wool ends

hemomancy.antecedent.vigil.title.about: a title card for the Antecedent vigil of the Last Listeners

hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.apot.about: the Mnemonist noting the record says Apotheos and offering to help the player still recover the memories they came for
the Mnemonist saying they can preserve the record of the Apotheos rite but will not call it finished yet

hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.sile.about: the Mnemonist saying Vesper's defeat is recorded but his memory is not, and telling the player to burn it in a lit Iron Brazier and draw it in with the Living Staff to close the record
the Mnemonist noting the record says Silentium, that Vesper's memory is now filed in the player, and that the older lessons remain available
the Mnemonist telling a player who refused that the record is not finished until Vesper falls

hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.unde.about: the Mnemonist offering to record what the player has seen while refusing to name what has not happened

hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_circu.about: narration of the Mnemonist folding a scarlet waybill along a line that tugs toward the nearest Circus

hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_start.about: narration of the Mnemonist smiling faintly because the player's blood already knows the motion of the chosen crude memory
narration of the Mnemonist handing over a crude memory shard whose echo waits for the player's blood
narration of the Mnemonist closing their hand around the echo because this lesson is not the player's to claim now

hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_woven.about: narration of the Mnemonist indexing the blank vessel, then walking the player through the Loom weave: choose Blood Shot with one bulb, 50 mL blood and one Vivacious Enzyme, hold the Living Staff, watch the fragment until it sounds, then sweep its thread along the star into the Loom
narration of the Mnemonist closing the archive and saying the vessel is already indexed, so the player should go and use what it taught
narration of the Mnemonist waiting beside an empty desk and saying they need a book, ink and three sheets of paper, since memory without an index is only hunger
narration of the Mnemonist extending an empty hand and saying the blank memory must come first because a lesson needs a vessel
narration of the Mnemonist listening to the player's pulse and refusing for now, telling them to return as an Initiate with the lessons still awake in their blood

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.conductive_.about: the Mnemonist recognizing the conductive pattern in the player's first weave, the one the Alchemist measured in Ductilis tissue, and noting it is one Noetic Memory with two routes to it

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.anch.about: asking the Mnemonist, on the Vein-Mason's advice, how a scar should bear a memory

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.ask_.about: asking the Mnemonist why they dream of a chamber
asking the Mnemonist what the Circus actually is
asking the Mnemonist to explain crude memories
asking the Mnemonist how to save a memory loadout
asking the Mnemonist what they can say about the item the player is holding
asking the Mnemonist to tell them about the Somatic Loom
asking the Mnemonist what blood-memory is
asking the Mnemonist how to choose which memories to keep ready
asking the Mnemonist to return to their earlier remark that memory has three movements
asking the Mnemonist to tell them about the Mnemonic Reliquary
asking the Mnemonist what the Scriptorium does
asking the Mnemonist how active manipulation slots work

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.begi.about: telling the Mnemonist to begin the guided glimpse of the Chamber

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.choo.about: choosing Blood Rush as the first crude memory
choosing Blood Shot as the first crude memory
choosing Deadly Gaze as the first crude memory
asking the Mnemonist to teach them a first crude memory

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.guid.about: asking the Mnemonist to guide them through the Chamber

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.leav.about: ending the conversation by saying they have heard enough

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.morp.about: asking the Mnemonist why their Morphling worries at the puppet threads

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.reli.about: asking the Mnemonist to show them how to weave the Reliquary

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.take.about: asking the Mnemonist for a waybill to the Circus pavilion

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.turn.about: telling the Mnemonist they have brought the blank vessel and archive materials

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.vagr.about: asking the Mnemonist where to look for a Vagrant Mind
asking the Mnemonist what the Vagrant Mind is
offering to tell the Mnemonist what they saw inside the Vagrant Mind

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.wove.about: asking the Mnemonist how to prepare a blank memory

hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.mnemonist.about: the Mnemonist greeting a newcomer, saying they seek a beginning and that the Vicar can give its shape

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.mnemonist.fir.about: a player question asking the Mnemonist what the first memory they ever heard was
the Mnemonist recalling a faded memory on their first shelf that kept only how to wait like a heron, which they listened to for a month and learned
a teaser line saying trading with the Mnemonist may earn the story of the first thing they heard

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.mnemonist.wha.about: a player question asking the Mnemonist what listening has cost them
the Mnemonist admitting listening cost them their own voice for a while, buried under many lessons not theirs, so they had to file themselves like any memory
the Mnemonist saying their own file sits on the lowest shelf and closing with an aphorism that a reachable shelf is one you visit
a teaser line saying the Mnemonist keeps some files closed to strangers

hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.acc.about: the Mnemonist accepting recruitment, calling it covenant and saying one lesson will be carried in more than one body

hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.con.about: the Mnemonist considering a bloodline bond, saying a bloodline is also a memory and that binding them adds 1,000 mL of blood to the shared pool

hemomancy.mnemonist.anchorite_counsel.li.about: the Mnemonist offering to explain what an instruction means and which tendency leads it, while leaving the carrying tissue to the Anchorite
the Mnemonist instructing the player to match an active cerebral scar to the Noetic Memory's primary tendency, then change the arrangement and prove the new route still bears the instruction

hemomancy.mnemonist.anchorite_counsel.pr.about: a prompt saying the Anchorite sent the player because memory and scar must agree, and to take the Mnemonist's counsel and return to prove both routes

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.famil.about: the Mnemonist telling a player who has already found the Chamber to come back with them once on purpose and look at what the dream missed

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.first.about: the Mnemonist saying the player may not remember the Chamber and offering to take them there long enough to look around with open eyes

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.rules.about: the Mnemonist laying out the rules of the guided glimpse: two minutes, tending the Arbor and moving temporary item copies allowed, no dropping, building or ordeals, original items restored, and returning home completes the lesson without attuning them

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.start.about: narration that the Mnemonist leads the player into the Chamber

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.unava.about: a system message saying the guided visit cannot begin yet and that the player must finish any item transfer and return with active blood and no other visit or projection underway

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line1.about: the Mnemonist identifying the player's dreamed place as their Chamber of Will, where ordinary sleep in early Degrees may grant a minute or two

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line2.about: the Mnemonist saying the player may walk the Chamber and tend the Arbor, and that objects and changes remain after waking

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line3.about: the Mnemonist explaining that at the third Degree the player can build a Somnolent Seat to visit on purpose and stay longer, and that the Chamber keeps what they build

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.rite.about: the Mnemonist explaining that attunement comes through the Rite of the Chamber of Will at the sixth Degree, not early dreams, guided glimpses or Seat visits, and needs no Mnemonist present

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.seat.control.about: the Mnemonist explaining Seat controls: sneak-use outside the Chamber to go straight in or sleep in it through a normal rest, and use the paired Seat beside the Arbor to start home

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.seat.duratio.about: the Mnemonist stating un-attuned Seat durations of five minutes at the third Degree, ten at the fourth and twenty from the fifth, with the return timed however the player entered

hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.support.about: the Mnemonist saying longer visits give time to work, that a Mnemonist serving the bloodline can help prepare and interpret them, and that neither the Seat nor the later rite requires one

hemomancy.mnemonist.circus.discovered.li.about: the Mnemonist acknowledging the player found the Circus pavilion and stating that the acts are the practice, with nothing hidden behind the show
the Mnemonist advising the player to watch who begins an act and who answers, since manifestations take shape in that exchange

hemomancy.mnemonist.circus.undiscovered..about: the Mnemonist describing a Harbinger company called the Circus that works through performance, where every body under the pavilion practices something different
the Mnemonist warning that the show is not an invitation, and that together the whole troupe can make one intention real, which is the danger

hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line1.about: the Mnemonist remarking that the silence around a player in Clarity is bright, painfully so

hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line2.about: the Mnemonist allowing questions from a player who left the Harbinger path, noting the old path is still on file but they will not return its living lessons

hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line1.about: the Mnemonist explaining crude memories are rough early echoes: use one, pay its blood cost, and the manipulation joins the known lessons

hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line2.about: the Mnemonist explaining that a new lesson files into an empty active slot, or waits in the library if every slot is full until the player learns the arranging

hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line1.about: the Mnemonist explaining the Dendritic Distributor saves named arrangements of known Noetic and Thelemic memories, teaches none, and keeps Blood Absorption and Blood Projection fixed outside custom patterns

hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line2.about: the Mnemonist stating that saving or overwriting a pattern costs 100 mL of blood and 25 raw XP, renaming and applying are free, and there are three pattern slots until Synaptic Memory adds more

hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line3.about: the Mnemonist explaining that applying a pattern checks capacity and known memories, replaces the active arrangement, and switches off any running Thelemic memory the pattern omits

hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line4.about: the Mnemonist giving the build recipe for the Distributor as a Working on a greater Working floor: frame Infested Venous Stone with four Iron Bars, hold a Sanguine Formation, offer a Tendon Line and Ferric Binder, feed it 500 mL of blood

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_hint.about: the Mnemonist asking the player to show what they carry so it can be sorted into what holds a memory and what only pretends to

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.crude_m.about: the Mnemonist identifying a crude Blood Rush shard as the body's memory of panic put to use as speed
the Mnemonist calling it an early lesson in movement and warning that fast blood is still blood spent
the Mnemonist identifying a crude Blood Shot shard as pressure and release, a line of blood drawn through the air, and as simple as lessons get
the Mnemonist noting it is unavailable before initiation, after which an empty active slot takes the lesson automatically
the Mnemonist identifying a crude Deadly Gaze shard as intent sent through the eyes before the hand moves, an ugly little lesson but a useful one
the Mnemonist warning that crude is not harmless and the player should be careful what they teach their blood to hate
the Mnemonist identifying a crude Glacial Grasp shard, Congeatio slowing the world until a mistake can be studied
the Mnemonist saying the cold means no harm and the stillness it buys can save the player's life
the Mnemonist identifying a crude Hematic Flare shard, Lux stretching blood thin and white so whatever hides stands lit
the Mnemonist warning it is not mercy, since it lets nothing go unseen, the caster included
the Mnemonist identifying a crude Hemorrhage shard as a small opening followed by insistence, with Mortem knowing how endings begin
the Mnemonist urging restraint because blood learns cruel habits easily and keeps them
the Mnemonist identifying a crude Sanguine Ignition shard as fever, a spark, the red thought before flame, filed under Flammeus
the Mnemonist calling it an eager lesson and warning against mistaking eagerness for mastery
the Mnemonist identifying a crude Sanguine Mending shard that repairs the caster, noting Ferric memory likes repair but takes payment first
the Mnemonist saying the wound closes while the player's reserve answers for it
the Mnemonist identifying a crude Void Shroud shard as Tenebris work that pulls the dark close so the caster breathes quietly under it
the Mnemonist noting it hides the caster from enemies and warning it may begin hiding them from themselves

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.enthral.about: the Mnemonist naming Enthralling Filament as a restraint fiber supplied by Peacock Spiders, surface Hemojellies and Blood Drunk Puppeteers, woven into memory by the Somatic Loom, with the Spindle storing its tension for a Crossbar
the Mnemonist telling the player to keep the filament, that at the second Degree they may study the fiber, and that a first true string waits until memory preparation is taught

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.hematic.about: the Mnemonist identifying a blank Hematic Memory, nothing written in it, a cup waiting for a voice
the Mnemonist explaining the Loom can weave a chosen lesson into it once the player's Degree and materials are ready

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.living_.about: the Mnemonist explaining a limb-pattern graft gives the Living Staff a shape to grow, though the staff still answers only through known manipulations
the Mnemonist telling the player to do the matching deed: craft the graft and burn it in the Brazier while the staff drinks the memory

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.memory_.about: the Mnemonist explaining Axonal Transduction, carried by the Naeglerophaeon's ganglion: absorb it in the Iron Brazier at the sixth Degree, recall and enable it with usual controls, and it needs sixty-five Ductilis alignment

the Mnemonist describing how it works: touching a Synaptic Node sends the body into the joined nerves, forward carries on, backward retraces, look to choose a branch, another node reforms the body, sneak passes or slows, each entry costs 150 mL and staying is free
the Mnemonist identifying Black Veil Covenant as Tenebris you can see, raising a chapel of dark blood and branching veins
the Mnemonist warning that inside its sphere the shadow is literal and the player should walk carefully
the Mnemonist filing Blackhearted under Mortem, teaching the heart to feed on the death meant for it
the Mnemonist warning of the limit: once the vessel saturates, the debt breaks inward and the lesson goes silent
the Mnemonist calling Blood Binding simple restraint, if another body is only blood taught to stay
the Mnemonist noting the tendrils start at the caster's feet, so the caster should keep footing, and they hold the target just as still
the Mnemonist identifying a refined Blood Rush memory with fewer burrs than the crude shard that spends its lesson more cleanly
the Mnemonist advising the player to keep the crude version on file since it taught the body how to begin
the Mnemonist identifying a refined Blood Shot memory as the same first line of force as the scraped shard, only cleaner
the Mnemonist noting full memories keep their rank gates, so the crystal can be ready before the player is
the Mnemonist identifying Cauterizing Rebuke as Flammeus used as medicine, if the player can stand the smell of burning
the Mnemonist explaining it burns venom and rot out of the caster and then treats nearby enemies the same way
the Mnemonist identifying Conductive Mark as a patient sign, bright enough for allied blood-work to find
the Mnemonist explaining that Ductilis, Lux and Ferric blows can catch the mark and leap from it into nearby enemies
the Mnemonist identifying Cruor Javelin as Congeatio that brings its own cold and throws it rather than waiting for the river
the Mnemonist explaining that what it strikes stiffens and iron finishes what the frost started
the Mnemonist identifying a refined Deadly Gaze as shaped on purpose, unlike the crude one scraped from old panic
the Mnemonist saying refining steadies a memory but the lesson stays as ugly as it was
the Mnemonist identifying Ferric Rampart as blood gathered into overlapping iron plates
the Mnemonist advising the player to learn it after the first level of Sanguine Magnetism and noting the wall needs firm ground and room to stand
the Mnemonist identifying Ferric Spikes as rusted blades rising from a line of blood
the Mnemonist explaining the second level of Sanguine Magnetism steadies their shape and Ductilis can run a current through the summoned iron
the Mnemonist saying Mortem never stops at one wound and Fruiting Contagion makes rot that has taken hold bear fruit
the Mnemonist clarifying it cannot start rot, only hurry it, so something must already be dying
the Mnemonist identifying a full memory crystal as stable, made on purpose, and fit for proper loadout work
the Mnemonist advising the player to carry one only if they mean to use it, since refined memories hold their shape longer than crude shards
the Mnemonist identifying Glacial Rampart as Congeatio cold stood upright on a spine of blood, frost settling
the Mnemonist saying it is a short-lived wall between the caster and harm that buys time
the Mnemonist identifying Gloam Laceration as a Tenebris knife kept where the light forgets to look
the Mnemonist explaining it bites deepest from a shroud or true darkness and what it opens keeps bleeding
the Mnemonist identifying Grave Debt as a Mortem ledger written against a living balance
the Mnemonist explaining that when the vessel falls low it bursts, and death may return a measure of blood to the creditor
the Mnemonist identifying Hematic Beacon as a signal fire carried under the skin
the Mnemonist explaining allies inside it hold steadier while every enemy inside stands lit for the covenant to name
the Mnemonist identifying the full Hematic Flare as Lux that strikes without waiting for the dark to confess
the Mnemonist explaining it brands hidden things and burns what it catches, turning concealment into a wound
the Mnemonist identifying Hematic Impressment as borrowed loyalty written directly into another pulse
the Mnemonist explaining only one vessel can bear the caster's command at a time and stronger blood sheds it sooner
the Mnemonist identifying Hematic Rebuke as a command sent down another body's nerves so it feels fear before any blade is drawn
the Mnemonist stating it cannot command bloodless bodies or greater wills
the Mnemonist identifying Hematic Riposte as raising a limb the body never grew that answers faster than the caster's own hand
the Mnemonist warning it guards only what the caster faces and only for a heartbeat, so a mistimed use spends blood on air
the Mnemonist identifying Insatiable Hunger as Mortem work that turns appetite against its own remedy
the Mnemonist explaining healing thins under it and food deepens the ache where it should comfort
the Mnemonist identifying Iron Retort as Ferric patience folded into a single answer
the Mnemonist explaining the guard takes and dulls the first bite, then answers through the attacker's own opening
the Mnemonist identifying Ironhearted as Ferric blood building a second pulse and shutting it in an iron cage
the Mnemonist advising the player to hold the memory steady until the metal closes and noting the borrowed heart is spent before their own
the Mnemonist identifying Lodestone Collapse as a point ahead of the caster becoming a lodestone that calls every nearby enemy home
the Mnemonist explaining enemies come in together and are crushed together, a wall shields them, and iron already in them is spent on the blow
the Mnemonist identifying Lumen Suture as Lux that can set a needle of light exactly where needed instead of lighting a room
the Mnemonist explaining a pale thread closes the pain and cuts blindness from the wound
the Mnemonist identifying Prismatic Reproof as judging a threat by splitting it into every color it tried to hide
the Mnemonist explaining it hits harder on prey already exposed by Illumination and the judgment uses up that light
the Mnemonist identifying Radiant Wake as Lux thin enough to bear the caster's weight, which will not lift them but will not let them fall
the Mnemonist explaining people near the caster stay mended, hostile things stay exposed, and the sky is paid for by being seen
the Mnemonist identifying Sanguine Magnetism as Ferric blood knowing where iron wants to gather
the Mnemonist explaining a pillar rises and hostile bodies are dragged close enough to hold still
the Mnemonist identifying Scalding Updraft as hot air rising from under the caster's own feet, kept in the blood
the Mnemonist explaining the player stands on the fire's breath and is thrown where their legs cannot, though it needs footing to push from
the Mnemonist identifying Searing Lash as Flammeus heat run along something swingable, since heat travels best that way
the Mnemonist explaining what it strikes is marked for greater burning and warning not to lash anything the player is unwilling to finish
the Mnemonist identifying Synaptic Jolt as the stopping side of Ductilis, which moves the body and can halt a nerve as readily
the Mnemonist explaining it is a short bolt that interrupts and staggers the struck vessel so it cannot answer cleanly for a moment
the Mnemonist identifying Umbral Rend as a hand closing on what is already held, with Tenebris needing to lay the dark on first
the Mnemonist saying a target with no shadow on it gives nothing to tear, so the player must wait
the Mnemonist identifying Umbral Reversal as stepping back out of a too-certain chase into the dark
the Mnemonist explaining it needs darkness to land the caster, or a Veil pretending the world has none, and leaves anyone close obscured

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.minecra.about: the Mnemonist identifying ordinary book pages as the start of every archive, a mundane store of knowledge that is still useful
the Mnemonist saying enough of these let them index blood-memory instead of guessing at it

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.mnemoni.about: the Mnemonist identifying a blank mnemonic blueprint that waits for spatial memory and cannot hold manipulation lessons
the Mnemonist explaining a blueprint holds a rite's distances, order and relations, mapping the rite without carrying any of its authority
the Mnemonist explaining a blueprint fixes a blood structure into something portable that guides the hand, though understanding must be the player's own
the Mnemonist explaining the Mnemonic Reliquary arranges Thelemic and Noetic Memories within one active loadout
the Mnemonist explaining the Reliquary chooses which known lessons sit nearest the pulse while new ones come from the memory item
the Mnemonist saying the Reliquary is a third-Degree weave and, until then, the player should let first bodily lessons settle into the open slots nearest the pulse

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.naegler.about: the Mnemonist hearing the ganglion still conduct and explaining the Loom recipe: beside a blank Hematic Memory in a Cortical-crowned Somatic Loom, four Neurotic enzymes, 600 mL of blood, yielding the sixth-Degree memory Axonal Transduction

the Mnemonist explaining how to lay Nerve Fibers or Bundles in one unbroken run with Synaptic Nodes at entrances and exits, leaving room for the body to reform, and noting a dormant Synaptic Step can be dismantled to return this organ

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.orb_of_.about: the Mnemonist explaining the Orb of Perspective is a fixed eye for a room built from memory, with skies drawn only from places its owner reached and nothing invented
the Mnemonist explaining that throwing it off the Chamber floor changes the remembered perspective and the Orb returns to whoever owns the cell

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.salt_st.about: the Mnemonist asking the player to hold a salt-ruined log still while it is read, and summarizing current marks, specimen counts and a prayer before the descent
the Mnemonist reading the log's last line, which asks the reader to use what they learned if they fail to surface, and quoting that this is what remains of them

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.scar_pa.about: the Mnemonist identifying an unwritten scar motif that the Effigy has not yet persuaded blood to leave a route on

the Mnemonist explaining a multi-route motif: put it in an empty Iron Brazier, light it with Blood Projection, hold Blood Absorption on the offering, costing 50 mL and replacing the active cerebral loadout
the Mnemonist identifying a single scar route written out as a carving lesson for the Cerebral Scarring Station
the Mnemonist identifying a scar pattern schema as instruction for flesh, tendency and threshold
the Mnemonist saying a pattern has no power of its own and only hands the blood a grammar, which the blood must be able to speak

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.somatic.about: the Mnemonist explaining the Somatic Loom takes tendency inputs, blood and a pattern and returns a blood memory woven on purpose
the Mnemonist contrasting a crude shard as an echo found by chance with a Loom crystal made to order
the Mnemonist saying the Somatic Loom stays closed before the third Degree and scraped echoes must carry the player a little longer

hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.unknown.about: the Mnemonist saying they hear no lesson in the held item, unless it is clever enough to keep quiet

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.claime.about: the Mnemonist telling the player the Cortical Crown is already theirs, since a loom wears only so much mind, and they now know how another is folded

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.prompt.about: a prompt option for asking the Mnemonist for the crown that lets the loom think the whole memory

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.ready.about: the Mnemonist praising a memory that stood taller for the player than most and telling them to take the crown plus five offerings to the Rite of the Cortical Weave

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.requir.about: the Mnemonist stating the Cortical Crown's requirements: first weave a Magister's memory on a Ganglionic Loom, then at the sixth Degree with blood awake the crown carries a Perfectus memory at full stature, no earlier harness needed

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.title.about: a short title for the Cortical Crown loom upgrade card

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.clai.about: the Mnemonist telling the player the Ganglionic Harness is already theirs, since a loom that has learned to feel does not forget, and they know how the nerve is bound

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.prom.about: a prompt option for asking the Mnemonist for the harness that lets the loom hear its own engram

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.read.about: the Mnemonist praising the player for threading a memory home and keeping it, handing over the harness, and telling them to set it with five more offerings at the Rite of the Ganglionic Weave

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.requ.about: the Mnemonist stating the Ganglionic Harness requirements: first weave one memory home at a Somatic Loom with every fragment threaded, keep blood awake, and at the fifth Degree receive a nerve harness letting the loom hold Magister memories

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.titl.about: a short title for the Ganglionic Harness loom upgrade card

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line1.about: the Mnemonist introducing the Somatic Loom as where scraped shards give way to memories woven on purpose

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line2.about: the Mnemonist explaining the Loom ritual: pay blood, an eight-pointed star engram opens with fragments at its points, and the player threads every fragment home along the star's lines with the staff without crossing two colors

hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line3.about: the Mnemonist warning some fragments are false, that the blood files failures as carefully as lessons, and that resting the eyes on a fragment shows its memory while a false one shows someone else's and beats against the loom

hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line1.about: the Mnemonist explaining Hematic Memory is repeatable instruction preserved in blood, with no whole life on their shelves, only what someone could do again

hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line2.about: the Mnemonist explaining some lessons are patterns projected through manipulation while others are prepared in the body and enacted when its vessels answer

hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_practice.line.about: the Mnemonist telling the player to choose the exact Loom recipe before paying blood, since the blank vessel and catalyst shape the weave and stored enzymes alone do not choose the result
the Mnemonist explaining the Reliquary arranges known Noetic and Thelemic memories within one active capacity and swapping the active set erases nothing learned

hemomancy.mnemonist.mnemonic_doctrine.li.about: the Mnemonist reciting a three-part saying that Mneme keeps, Nous knows and Thelema acts
the Mnemonist unpacking the saying: memory keeps the trace, intellect sees its pattern, will enacts it, with Noetic and Thelemic practice being two methods on one substrate
the Mnemonist admitting these are working labels kept because their predictions earn their keep

hemomancy.mnemonist.morphling_puppet_int.about: the Mnemonist explaining the incorporated organism feels projected will as foreign tension and worries at it like edible tissue
the Mnemonist explaining the puppet's imposed will pushes back, its repeated intent scatters the organism's attention and its feeding rhythm falters
the Mnemonist saying neither practice rules out the other and the player may keep both, though the divided strain makes each less efficient

hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line1.about: the Mnemonist greeting a Neophyte and saying they can hear the first crude echoes gathering around them

hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line2.about: the Mnemonist telling the player that crude memories in old places still work, to use one and learn it, and at the second Degree bring that experience and choose one on purpose

hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line1.about: narration of the Mnemonist's eyes softening while their hands fold closed

hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line2.about: the Mnemonist telling a player purging lessons from their blood that questions will be answered but no new memory will be pressed into a wound they are cleaning

hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line1.about: the Mnemonist explaining the Reliquary keeps lessons already survived as an orderly shelf, with the learning still coming from the memories themselves

hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line2.about: the Mnemonist explaining the Reliquary arranges Noetic and Thelemic Memories into one active loadout, changing what sits near the surface while the deeper library stays in the player

hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.eightfol.about: the Mnemonist explaining that at the fifth Degree the Rite of the Eightfold Script rules the lines in red so one inscription can be singled out above the rest

hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.material.about: the Mnemonist giving the Scriptorium build recipe as a Working on a greater Working floor: an Enchanting Table with Sanguine Glass and Hematic Iron Blocks, hold a Ferric Binder, offer an Enzyme Primer, a Blood Crystal Shard and a Lapis Block, and feed 500 mL of blood

hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.palimpse.about: the Mnemonist refusing to issue the Palimpsest burin twice because it is already the player's, who now knows how to shape another
a prompt option for asking the Mnemonist for the burin that writes over what was written
the Mnemonist praising the player for choosing a line and making it stay, handing over the burin, and telling them to take it with five more offerings to the Rite of the Palimpsest

the Mnemonist stating the Palimpsest burin requirements: first learn ordinary inscription, then single out an inscription at an Eightfold Scriptorium, and at the seventh Degree with blood awake the burin cuts where the quill only marked
a short title for the Palimpsest Burin Scriptorium upgrade card
the Mnemonist explaining that at the seventh Degree the Rite of the Palimpsest scrapes the page back to what the blood remembers so the chosen inscription can be cut deeper than ink allows

hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.role.about: the Mnemonist explaining the Loom weaves memories to learn while the Scriptorium inscribes equipment, an optional workshop the Woven Vessel does not need

hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.rubricat.about: the Mnemonist saying the quill is already the player's and, if another is needed, they know how it is cut
a prompt option for asking the Mnemonist for the quill that marks one line in red
the Mnemonist confirming the player has written at a Scriptorium, handing over the quill, and telling them to set it with five more offerings at the Rite of the Eightfold Script
the Mnemonist stating the Rubricator's Quill requirements: first write something at a Scriptorium, keep blood awake, and at the fifth Degree the Mnemonist will lend the quill the old rubricators used
a short title for the Rubricator's Quill Scriptorium upgrade card

hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line1.about: the Mnemonist explaining active mnemonic slots hold the Noetic and Thelemic lessons the blood keeps near the surface while the whole memory reaches past them

hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line2.about: the Mnemonist explaining crude lessons may fill empty slots on their own early on and later the Reliquary lets the player choose which lessons sleep close to the pulse

hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line1.about: the Mnemonist telling the player to choose one crude memory for the field, noting one already learned stays with them, choosing erases nothing, and only one shard can be given

hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line2.about: the Mnemonist advising the player to choose by instinct among reach, motion or gaze

hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line1.about: narration of a robed Harbinger pressing two fingers to their own wrist, listening to a pulse the player cannot hear

hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line2.about: the Mnemonist turning away an uninitiated player, saying blood keeps its mouth closed for an uncut heir, and promising to teach them to listen without drowning after initiation

hemomancy.mnemonist.votary.line1.about: the Mnemonist telling a Votary to choose a crude memory for reach, motion or gaze and use it in the field, with the Reliquary coming later to arrange known lessons

hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line1.about: the Mnemonist telling the player their blood knows enough words now that crude shards will no longer do

hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line2.about: the Mnemonist explaining the Loom weaves a chosen lesson thread by thread and the finished crystal teaches it without a word

hemomancy.mnemonist.woven_vessel.archive.about: the Mnemonist telling the player to bring the blank vessel with a book, ink and paper so they can index the first lesson, with the weaving still happening at the Loom

hemomancy.mnemonist.woven_vessel.recipe..about: the Mnemonist giving the recipe for one blank Hematic Memory from four Sanguine Formations, four Blood Stained Stones and one Neurotic Enzyme

the Mnemonist explaining where to get Blood Stained Stone, in a Hermitage Remnant or crafted from Venous Stone, a Sanguine Formation and redstone, bringing the blank to eight formations, and that Chicken blood can yield Neurotic Enzyme though some spins yield Vivacious

hemomancy.succession.fracture.mnemonist.about: a fractured, echoing voice of the Mnemonist saying they remember the player remembering them

hemomancy.succession.profession.mnemonis.about: a short profession label naming the Mnemonist

hemomancy.succession.teaching.mnemonist.about: the Mnemonist teaching that a Bequest is permission not possession, that a dead successor leaves a Bound Mnemonic Remnant restored with an Effigy, Quintessence, the player's blood and a free workplace without new Ambergris, recovered at the fane bloodwell if lost, and old copies go inert

hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.appraise.poor.about: the Mnemonist rejecting an offered empty jar because there is nothing in it to hear

hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.books.line.about: the Mnemonist offering a trade of two books for the index in exchange for three glow ink sacs, calling it a fair exchange for once

hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.books.title.about: a short title for the books-for-glow-ink trade card

hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.faded_memories.about: the Mnemonist describing a trade for two faded memories whose lesson has gone but whose thread remains
a short title for the faded memories trade card

hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.living_specime.about: the Mnemonist describing a trade for one jar holding a living specimen, listening to what it carries, with the infection's own creatures carrying more
a short title for the living specimen trade card

hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.thanks.about: the Mnemonist briefly acknowledging a completed trade by saying it is filed

hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.thanks_fine.about: the Mnemonist acknowledging a fine trade item still humming and filing it with thanks

hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.bearing.about: the Mnemonist saying they have placed a likely Vagrant Mind in the outer End near given X and Z coordinates, and telling the player to find the Cortical Drift around it and follow its nerve bridges

hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.bearing_m.about: the Mnemonist reporting no Vagrant Mind was found in the searched part of the outer End and telling the player to travel farther among the outer islands and ask again

hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology.p.about: a prompt option for reporting the Mind visit and nearby biology, noting no specimen is handed over

hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology_l.about: the Alchemist telling the player to visit the Vagrant Mind and then watch a Choir Keeper, Myelin Borer or living chorus growth, wanting the living system around the Mind rather than a list of kills

hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology_r.about: the Alchemist noting the player has seen the Mind and something alive around its network, asking for their findings, and mentioning the Mnemonist can take a separate report on the same visit
a system note that the Alchemist recorded the field observation and the Mnemonist's inquiry stays open if not yet reported

hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory.pr.about: a prompt option for giving the Mnemonist an account of the Vagrant Mind, noting it costs and earns no memory slot

hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory_fo.about: the Mnemonist asking the player, who has stood inside the Mind, to describe what held its nerve web together, with no piece of it needed

hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory_le.about: the Mnemonist telling the player a Cortical Drift in the outer End holds a hollow Vagrant Mind, asking them to study its nerve web and report on memory organized outside a familiar body, with no trophy wanted

hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory_re.about: a system note that the Mnemonist recorded the player's account and that their memory loadout and costs are unchanged

hemomancy.vicar.circus_referral.mnemonis.about: the Vicar sending the player to the Mnemonist about their practice, to ask for a Scarlet Waybill as a route back, and assuring them the next Degree does not depend on anything done at the pavilion
